assumptions.online_sessions: one continuous3h/day; last completed attempt may overrun by up to one cycle
assumptions.offline_note: 8h is per-login cap, not per-day; multiple separated logins can earn more and progress faster
assumptions.rod: tile/carbon tier2 assumed; battle physics not simulated
assumptions.upgrades: already owned at baseline; no further boat/tank expansion; prices not included in goal budget
assumptions.recommended_operation: keep5 fish; replace cheapest displayed owner with more valuable new owner; recover old fish to sell; all non-displayed fish sold after first donations
assumptions.fixed_comparison: never replace the initial5, income remains fixed
assumptions.money_scope: first main/sub/owner donations forego sales; one-time rewards31200/93600 unchanged; each bait usage charged
assumptions.proposed_price_scope: new balance prospective catches; initial prospective5 owners use candidate prices; NO repricing existing saves has been approved
assumptions.excluded: bag/travel/management time,real fight/reaction,robot,expedition,other grants,previous savings; actual license/content readiness not simulated
assumptions.statistics: 5seeds x3baits=15 paths per profile; min/max are observed sample ranges, not CI or universal guarantee
